conclusion.interpretation: No sufficient, stable ranking gain with the confirmed identification guards in this complete configuration. Do not generalize this to all weighted pooling or negate the earlier Chinese BGE improvement.

limitations: Saved-result replay does not recompute all label-dependent metrics from formal ground truth.
GPU updates and earlier weight custody are supported by saved execution records, not repeated live model checks.
Intervals are conditional on fixed fitted seeds/models, synthetic groups and thresholds; they do not include retraining variation or repeated-valid selection correction.
Evaluation has 27 within-group candidates and 1 or 2 relevant aliases per query; it is not whole-corpus or open-query retrieval or real-market validation.
Observed identification guards are not population noninferiority proofs; no attention-distribution evidence identifies the cause of the negative result.
Trained weights, including D, were explicitly deleted; saved statistical evidence remains reproducible, new inference does not.
